changeSet.author: cabrasky
changeSet.comment: Access grant audit: how each user obtained their profiles and group roles (manual grant vs invitation type)

changeSet.author: cabrasky
changeSet.comment: Nominative invitations: track which user used the invitation and when (like project_role_invitation)

changeSet.author: cabrasky
changeSet.comment: Backfill: link used nominative invitations to the user by email (best effort)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE nominative_invitations ni SET used_by_user_id = u.id, used_at = u.created_at FROM "user" u WHERE ni.used = true AND ni.used_by_user_id IS NULL AND LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(ni.email);

changeSet.author: cabrasky
changeSet.comment: Backfill: LINK invitations → access_grant from invitation_registration (profiles granted by the invitation)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO access_grant (user_id, grant_type, profile_id, source, invitation_type, invitation_id, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT ir.user_id, 'PROFILE', ip.profile_id, 'INVITATION', 'LINK', ir.invitation_id, i.invited_by, ir.registered_at FROM invitation_registration ir JOIN invitations i ON i.id = ir.invitation_id JOIN invitation_profile ip ON ip.invitation_id = ir.invitation_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM access_grant ag WHERE ag.user_id = ir.user_id AND ag.invitation_type = 'LINK' AND ag.invitation_id = ir.invitation_id AND ag.profile_id = ip.profile_id AND ag.revoked_at IS NULL );

changeSet.author: cabrasky
changeSet.comment: Backfill: NOMINATIVE invitations used → access_grant (profiles granted by the invitation)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO access_grant (user_id, grant_type, profile_id, source, invitation_type, invitation_id, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT ni.used_by_user_id, 'PROFILE', nip.profile_id, 'INVITATION', 'NOMINATIVE', ni.id, ni.invited_by, ni.used_at FROM nominative_invitations ni JOIN nominative_invitation_profile nip ON nip.nominative_invitation_id = ni.id WHERE ni.used_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM access_grant ag WHERE ag.user_id = ni.used_by_user_id AND ag.invitation_type = 'NOMINATIVE' AND ag.invitation_id = ni.id AND ag.profile_id = nip.profile_id AND ag.revoked_at IS NULL );

changeSet.author: cabrasky
changeSet.comment: Backfill: PROJECT_ROLE invitations → access_grant (group role granted by the invitation, from usage history)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO access_grant (user_id, grant_type, project_group_id, role, source, invitation_type, invitation_id, granted_by, granted_at) SELECT priu.user_id, 'GROUP_ROLE', pg.id, pri.role, 'INVITATION', 'PROJECT_ROLE', priu.invitation_id, pri.created_by, priu.used_at FROM project_role_invitation_usage priu JOIN project_role_invitation pri ON pri.id = priu.invitation_id JOIN project_group pg ON pg.project_id = pri.project_id AND pg.name IS NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM access_grant ag WHERE ag.user_id = priu.user_id AND ag.invitation_type = 'PROJECT_ROLE' AND ag.invitation_id = priu.invitation_id AND ag.revoked_at IS NULL );

changeSet.author: cabrasky
changeSet.comment: Backfill: existing user_profile rows → access_grant as MANUAL legacy (granted_by unknown, timestamp = user.created_at)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO access_grant (user_id, grant_type, profile_id, source, granted_at) SELECT up.user_id, 'PROFILE', up.profile_id, 'MANUAL', COALESCE(u.created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FROM user_profile up JOIN "user" u ON u.id = up.user_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM access_grant ag WHERE ag.user_id = up.user_id AND ag.grant_type = 'PROFILE' AND ag.profile_id = up.profile_id AND ag.source = 'MANUAL' AND ag.revoked_at IS NULL );

changeSet.author: cabrasky
changeSet.comment: Backfill: existing user_project_group rows → access_grant as MANUAL legacy (granted_by unknown, timestamp = user.created_at)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO access_grant (user_id, grant_type, project_group_id, role, source, granted_at) SELECT upg.user_id, 'GROUP_ROLE', upg.project_group_id, upg.role::text, 'MANUAL', COALESCE(u.created_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) FROM user_project_group upg JOIN "user" u ON u.id = upg.user_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM access_grant ag WHERE ag.user_id = upg.user_id AND ag.grant_type = 'GROUP_ROLE' AND ag.project_group_id = upg.project_group_id AND ag.role = upg.role::text AND ag.source = 'MANUAL' AND ag.revoked_at IS NULL );
